aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:857.title: General Manager- The Shrine Auditorium & Expo Hall
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:857.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The General Manager is responsible for overall management, promotion and operation of the facility including booking, finance, marketing, staffing, production maintenance and all related operations. Duties include providing leadership and direction to subordinate operating departments, management of staff, coordination and execution of plans and directives, and acting as liaison with corporate staff, industry associates, governing agencies, communication media and the general public. Essential Functions Responsible for recruiting, hiring, training, supervising, compensation, succession planning and evaluating management, administrative, and supervisory staff. Determines and establishes organizational structure and personnel staffing requirements. Assures the development and maintenance of employee job descriptions, duties, responsibilities, and performance standards for all positions with provisions for timely and effective employee performance evaluations. Plans, organizes, coordinates and directs all activities and personnel. Engaged in maintaining and operating the facilities. Evaluates existing policies and procedures and recommends improvements for the facility and/or improve the efficiency and safety of operations. Oversee development of annual operating calendar, activities schedule, dates and hours of operations, projections for attendance and revenue. Prepares, implements and monitors a detailed program budget. Supervises cost accounting required of assigned events to include facility rental, box office fees, house equipment rentals, supplies and services purchased, event supervision, ushers, ticket takers, ticket sellers, security officers, announcers, parking attendants, stage managers and stage crew. Prepares and maintains required reports/records for the city and/or the management firm. Provides for control of day-to-day operations, assuring the coordination of plans, programs and events and conducts post event operational and financial review and analysis. Ensures that all production/operations are conducted in accordance with applicable local, state and federal regulations such as OSHA and CalOSHA requirements. Required Qualifications BA/BS Degree (4-year) 10+ years Of related work experience, Experience and knowledge in overseeing physical venue, Experience with management, leadership and conflict resolution. Must have management experience and exceptional leadership abilities Must have proven track record of developing and managing budgets. Computer savvy and proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook. Self-motivated with the ability to work in a fast paced environment Excellent written, listening and verbal communication skills. Must be creative, detail-oriented person with an outgoing personality Knowledge of music industry preferred Payscale: $150,000.00 - $197,205.75 Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan require

claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:e5849fb3-.description: Manager, Recruiter Enablement Location Open to Remote in EST or CST Locations Clasp Talent About Us Clasp is a mission-driven, venture-backed startup transforming access to education and career pathways—starting with the healthcare workforce. By enabling employers to invest in future talent where it matters most—easing overwhelming student debt—our platform creates lasting bonds between employers and employees. We believe that when employers have a stake in the cost of education, we can create a more sustainable, equitable, and skilled workforce. Fresh off our Series B, we’re entering our next phase of growth. Clasp is a Forbes Fintech 50 company, an SHRM portfolio company, and has been named by Business Insider as one of the “Top 14 Healthcare Startups to Watch in 2026” and one of the “43 Startups to Bet Your Career On in 2025.” We’re not just building a fintech product—we’re driving economic mobility. If you’re excited to build, grow, and make a real impact, join us. What We Need We’re hiring a Manager, Recruiter Enablement to help recruiting teams at our employer partners understand, adopt, and confidently use Clasp in the hiring process. This role will build the training, tools, and playbooks recruiters need to communicate Clasp’s value to candidates and embed it into day-to-day recruiting workflows. You’ll work closely with Partner Success, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Talent Ecosystem teams to drive recruiter readiness and adoption. What You’ll Need - 5–9+ years of experience in recruiter enablement, talent acquisition, customer success, sales enablement, or partner enablement. - Experience working with recruiting, HR, or talent acquisition teams. - Self-starter who can build and define this role from the ground up. - Strong written and verbal communication skills; a highly engaging presenter. - Experience creating enablement content such as playbooks, templates, decks, or trainings. - Strong project management skills and the ability to work cross-functionally. - A practical, operator mindset and comfort building programs from scratch. Nice to Have - Healthcare recruiting, HR tech, or benefits experience. - Experience supporting high-volume or hard-to-fill recruiting environments. - Familiarity with student loan repayment or financial wellness programs. What We Give In Return - Competitive cash and equity compensation - Health benefits (health, dental, & vision), 401k - Commuter benefits - Flexible PTO policy - Opportunities to grow and perform in a fast-paced environment alongside a stellar team. Salary The salary range for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and industry knowledge, ranging between 130,000 - 150,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, we offer an attractive equity component as part of our compensation package, providing an opportunity for eligible employees to share in the success and growth of our company. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5f3547e9-c49a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Analista Financeiro Pleno TI based in Brazil. This is an opportunity to support the financial operations of a technology environment, with strong interaction across Finance, IT Governance, internal teams, and suppliers. The role focuses on ensuring accuracy, organization, traceability, and efficiency across purchasing, payments, accounting entries, and financial controls. You will manage day-to-day processes involving purchase requests, invoices, payments, assets, and budget monitoring. The position offers meaningful exposure to technology-related financial operations, including CAPEX and OPEX activities. A hands-on, analytical approach will be essential to identify and resolve issues while keeping processes on track. You will work remotely in a dynamic environment where autonomy, attention to detail, and collaboration are highly valued. This is a strong opportunity for a finance professional looking to deepen their experience in technology and cloud-oriented operations. Manage and follow up on purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and related internal requests. Open and monitor service tickets associated with purchasing and financial processes. Support the creation of orders and the registration and control of fixed assets and CAPEX activities. Perform financial and accounting entries in SAP, including processes such as MIRO, MIR7, FB60, ME53N/ME51N, KSB1, and FBL1N. Execute cost postings and reclassifications, including transfers between companies when required. Monitor payment scheduling and completion, ensuring deadlines and internal procedures are followed. Process and control invoices, debit notes, invoices from suppliers, leasing expenses, and corporate card expenditures. Support supplier registration and maintenance processes. Keep internal Technology Accounts Payable controls accurate and up to date. Support the monitoring of budgets, actual spending, and financial commitments within the technology area. Liaise with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve billing, payment, and documentation issues. Maintain the organization, traceability, accuracy, and quality of financial information. Requirements: Previous experience in financial routines, accounts payable, purchasing, controllership, or related functions. Practical experience with SAP , particularly financial processes and accounting-related transactions. Experience handling purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, and payments. Knowledge of accounting entries and cost reclassification processes. Intermediate to advanced Excel skills. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to independently follow up on activities and resolve operational issues. Clear communication skills and ease in interacting with internal teams and external suppliers. Hands-on profile with strong attention to detail, prioritization skills, and ownership of day-to-day processes. Nice to have: experience with IT budgets, CAPEX/OPEX, fixed assets, Power BI, or Technology/IT Governance environments. Benefits: Remote work. Flexible working hours.
